consumer: mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) asks 'does the player hold the required count of the courier item?' to decide whether the mission can be turned in
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (own carried items PLUS adjacent reachable map/vehicle items), not only on-person carried_items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete — its body computes the completion yes/no by calling u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a count_by_charges fallback)
divergence: the required courier items sit in a container on a tile adjacent to the player (within crafting-inventory reach) but not on the player's person: real is_complete returns true (ready to hand in), but a re-derivation from avatar.carried_items[] returns false
